test_arctan2: test the trigonometric ATAN2D and ATAN2 SQL functions with quadrant coordinates
test_trig: test all trigonometric SQL functions including sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, cot and their degree variants
test_sql_arctan2_with_dataframe: test pl.sql with ATAN2D and ATAN2 functions on a DataFrame with y and x coordinates
test_trig_functions_with_sqlcontext: test trigonometric functions via pl.SQLContext.execute with sin, cos, tan, cot, asin, acos, atan
test_trig_edge_cases_with_tolerance: test trigonometric SQL functions with edge cases like zero division and NaN results using abs_tol
